description: The chart illustrates the distribution of three categories - Context, Generated Response, and Other - across two methods, "Ours" and "Standard". The vertical axis represents the categories, labeled as "Ours" and "Standard", while the horizontal axis represents the percentage values, ranging from 0 to an implied maximum value, with no explicit label or scale type indicated. The chart features stacked bars, with each bar comprising three segments colored blue, orange, and green, corresponding to Context, Generated Response, and Other, respectively. For "Ours", the blue segment represents approximately 60.6%, the orange segment represents 31.7%, and the green segment represents 7.7%, although the exact value is not shown. For "Standard", the blue segment represents 23.6%, the orange segment represents 51.1%, and the green segment represents 25.3%. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the relative proportions of the three categories for each method.
